name: eos-face-verification
description: Use when verifying EOS frontend behavior, authenticated product journeys, Work continuity, persistence read-back, evidence visibility, authorization boundaries, navigation continuity, rendered state, or human-facing E2E behavior. Never accept source-code inspection alone as proof of rendered FACE behavior when runtime/browser verification is available.
author: EOS Development Team
trigger: Verifying EOS frontend behavior after implementation
Checking Work continuity across surface transitions
Verifying persistence read-back and evidence visibility
Before releasing any FACE surface change to production

inputs: surface_url: string - URL of the FACE surface to verify
work_id: string - Associated work item identifier
actor_context: object - Verifier's permissions and session
outputs: runtime_verdict: boolean - PASS/FAIL based on actual browser runtime
evidence_chain: object - Complete end-to-end verification evidence
continuity_validation: object - Work and state continuity check results

preconditions: eos-evidence-engine is available to process verification evidence
FACE surface is deployed to a test/runtime environment
Canonical server state is accessible for comparison

risks: Claiming rendered state works based solely on source code inspection
Client-side security checks replacing server-side authorization
Broken Work continuity when moving between surfaces
Missing evidence chain for frontend actions
risk_assessment.impact: High - incorrect FACE verification leads to mismatches between user-visible state and canonical EOS state
risk_assessment.mitigation: Mandatory runtime/browser verification never rely solely on source code, verify full state loop from user action to persistence and read-back

authority_boundaries: Can only run verification tests and produce reports, cannot modify frontend or backend code
Can only write verification reports to .eos-state/face/
Cannot modify locked directories: packages/eos-core/foundations/, src/eos/semantics/
Must always verify full evidence chain not just UI rendering
